verdict.rationale: Lovable's autonomous execution ('Build mode') only runs synchronously in response to a user's chat request, not as a scheduled/background automation the user configures once and forgets. The only scheduled autonomous process mentioned (lovable-docs-37) is an Enterprise-only security scan, not a general-purpose automation capability for a user's own app logic, and no evidence describes cron jobs, scheduled workflows, or background triggers available to end users.
